stem.text: Monochromatic light of wavelength $690\,\text{nm}$ passes through a diffraction grating with $300\,\text{lines per mm}$, producing a series of maxima (bright spots) on a screen.

stem.alt: Diagram of a curved screen with a flat diffraction grating placed in front of it. An arrow points at the grating from the lower left. Labels: screen, diffraction grating.

stem.text: What is the greatest number of maxima that can be observed?
